content.content: When invoked as `deccy new` without `-m <summary>`, the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation and create nothing.
content.rationale: A birth is described at creation — S3-new fixes that the summary is given, never defaulted — so an invocation that gives none cannot produce the change it promises. Refusing inside the form mirrors the `--on` case: the two parts D12 makes required refuse the same way, before anything is created.
